# StatPearls: Acute Pharyngitis and Tonsillitis

## Clinical Presentation
Acute pharyngitis presents with sore throat, fever, and pharyngeal erythema.

## Modified Centor Criteria
The modified Centor score helps estimate the probability of Group A Streptococcal infection:
- Tonsillar exudates or swelling (+1)
- Tender anterior cervical lymphadenopathy (+1)
- History of fever >38.0 C (+1)
- Absence of cough (+1)
- Age 3-14 (+1), Age 15-44 (0), Age >=45 (-1)

A score >=3 warrants rapid antigen testing or throat culture prior to antibiotic consideration.
